messages:
dave: Heads-up — Aperture Logistics POC hit a hard stop. Security wants customer KMS AND VPC peering + evidence of no egress to external regions before procurement will sign. They want a short exec review.
leah: Do they need a full VPC peering (route tables, SGs) or just a private link?
miguel: Email thread says VPC peering between their AWS acct and our private deployment in us-east-1, plus BYO-KMS. They also asked if we can restrict model routing to single region.
dave: Correct. Procurement says no cross-region traffic. They also want a sample ATO/controls pack for their InfoSec review.
toni: I can handle the ATO pack if we confirm the data residency plan and key control model.
eric (vp sales): I can join an exec call today if we have a pricing delta and a short risk summary. What's the expected cost delta for a private VPC peering POC vs hosted?
miguel: Quick take: configuring VPC peering + private deployment staging + ops runbook ~ 4 eng-days total; add Dedicated reserved node for isolation maybe ~$12k for a 2-week POC versus ~$3.5k hosted. Need finance buy-in for one-off setup fees.
leah: For BYO-KMS we need a registration flow, proof no plaintext key export, and a KMS grant that limits usage to the inference runtime. I can draft the KMS section.
dave: Legal wants to know if we can produce audit logs to their SIEM (Logstash/Splunk) and provide a signed attestation for controls. Do we have a SOC2 excerpt ready?
toni: We have a SOC2 summary doc. I'll attach the relevant pages once KMS and peering design is confirmed.
eric (vp sales): If procurement needs a fast yes, I need a one-pager with cost, top 3 risks, mitigation, and required exec actions. Can someone do that in the next 4 hours?
miguel: I'll own the risks + network design sketch. dave can you get the procurement email and timeline?
dave: On it. I'll forward the procurement lead contact: maria.procure@aperture.com. They want a 14-day POC starting next Monday.
notabot: /deploy status: staging-private not provisioned for aperture-poc.
leah: Question for infra: can we provision a temporary private deployment in us-east-1 that peered with customer VPC without full infra work?
miguel: Short answer yes with some automation; the tricky bit is key management handoff and routing policy. We should estimate a one-time infra ops fee.
toni: I'll prep the ATO summary and SOC2 pages. Need the KMS design doc to state we never persist plaintext keys and that KMS grants only the runtime.
dave: Can we get a quick quote for the one-off setup + 2-week Dedicated? If yes, I'll escalate to their procurement director and loop in legal.
eric (vp sales): I can sign a commercial term up to $15k one-off if finance ok; otherwise need CFO/CEO sign. Try to keep ask within that.
miguel: I'll draft numbers and share a short spreadsheet. ETA 60 min.
leah: Also need to confirm whether SSO domain allowlist is doable for their enterprise SSO (Okta). That was another checklist item.
dave: Their Okta tenant is aperture.okta.com. They want an allowlist and SCIM user provisioning for the POC admin accounts.
miguel: SCIM + domain allowlist low effort. KMS + peering is the real work.
eric (vp sales): Sending a quick note to execs to stand by for a 1pm bridge if we can produce numbers.
dave: Procurement responded — they can provision the KMS key and initiate peering once we sign an MOU. They've asked for the cost estimate first.
notabot: Meeting created: aperture-poc-bridge 2025-06-18T20:00:00Z (13:00 ET).
miguel: Shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/aperture-poc-quote (internal) — summary: Private peering setup = $8k setup + Dedicated 2-week = $11k, hosted fallback = $4k.
toni: I'll attach SOC2 pages and draft attestation after I verify KMS text from leah.
eric (vp sales): Good work. If we keep the one-off under $8k I can approve. dave, get legal on standby for the MOU.
dave: Legal looped in. Closing update: procurement requires quote -> we provided estimate -> bridge scheduled. Will update after 1pm bridge.
